 Toyota
 Toyota has issued a recall for more than 105k Toyota Land Cruiser and Land Cruiser Hybrid vehicles. These vehicle models were from 2024 to 2027.
 The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration says the fuel tube near the fuel tank could detach and start leaking, creating a fire risk.
 Toyota will send letters to owners of affected vehicles starting on November 9.
 The ID numbers for affected models are26TB23 and 26TA23
 Owners are advised to bring their vehicles to a dealership where they can get replacement parts for free.
